notes.title: 🎉 New Update Alert: Zen Rage - Campaign Mode Now Live! 🎉
notes.content:
Get ready to dive into the all-new Campaign Mode with 9 exciting levels, each packed with unique challenges and storyline twists! Here’s what’s new:

🔥 Campaign Mode with 9 Levels: Experience the new story-driven campaign where you’ll journey through diverse environments, each with distinct goals. From guiding ants with food trails to battling the Ant Queen herself, each level offers a fresh way to unleash your rage (and creativity!) in-game.

💥 Epic Boss Fight: Confront the Ant Queen in an intense battle, using all the tools and skills you’ve mastered throughout the campaign.

🎶 New Sound Effects & Animation: Enjoy immersive new sound effects, character animations, and cinematic cutscenes that bring each level to life.

💡 Level Advancement & Dynamic Challenges: Every level introduces new tasks—target practice, carving sculptures, or raking zen gardens. Complete objectives and progress through the campaign, with new win requirements adding depth to every playthrough.

📈 Updated Stats & Reports: Track your campaign progress and celebrate your victories with enhanced stats and hilarious end-of-game reports.

Update now to explore Zen Rage’s Campaign Mode and unleash your inner destroyer in a whole new way! 🧪

notes.title: Start the game with --screenshot argument!
notes.content:
New Feature: Instant Screenshot Mode for Streamers & Players!

We’ve added a handy new feature to Zen Rage! If you start the game with the [i]--screenshot[/i] argument, it will automatically capture a screenshot of your current screen and jump straight into the game—letting you instantly unleash your destructive zen rage.

For an even smoother experience, you can bind this function to a keyboard shortcut! This is perfect for streamers: after losing a life or facing a tough moment, you can capture that scene, then vent your frustration by smashing the screen. It’s both stress-relieving for you and sure to get a laugh from your viewers!

[b]Step 1: Create a Shortcut with the Argument[/b]

    Right-click on your desktop or in any folder where you want the shortcut to appear.
    Select New > Shortcut.
    In the Create Shortcut window, enter the full path to the application followed by the argument. For example:

    [i]"C:\path\to\ZenRage.exe" --screenshot[/i]

    Make sure to include quotes around the path if it contains spaces.
    Click Next, give the shortcut a name (e.g., "Zen Rage Screenshot"), and click Finish.

[b]Step 2: Assign a Keyboard Shortcut[/b]

    Right-click the shortcut you just created and choose Properties.
    In the Shortcut tab, click on the Shortcut key field.
    Press the key combination you'd like to use (e.g., [i]Ctrl + Alt + Z[/i]). The field will automatically fill with your chosen shortcut.
    Click Apply and then OK.

Now, whenever you press your chosen key combination, Windows will run the app with the --screenshot argument!

Let the chaos begin!

notes.title: Re-configure PyInstaller to make the anti-virus software happy
notes.content:
Building distributables with PyInstaller often triggers anti-virus software flags. https://stackoverflow.com/questions/43777106/program-made-with-pyinstaller-now-seen-as-a-trojan-horse-by-avg
There's really no way around it for python programs, but to make the code as transparent as possible (avoid bundling, compressing, and encrypting data).

So we did just that. We tried to make the executable as transparent as possible, which showed great result, and now only 2 out of the 72 virus-scanners still get triggered.
https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/321e0e57f5f537ec695a974dd359224c5fa2f351425bc2a390a897b9a0b315f3/behavior

Hurray!

Now our players will not get a heart-attack, since their AV software will not raise any alarms.
